Life in a Year (2020)
Life in a Year (2020) is an emotional romantic drama starring Jaden Smith as Daryn, a talented teenager with his entire future planned out. He has ambitious parents, excellent grades, and dreams of becoming a successful professional. But his carefully planned life changes when he discovers that his girlfriend Isabelle has terminal cancer and may have only one year left to live.
Instead of accepting that they have so little time together, Daryn makes an extraordinary decision: he wants to give Isabelle an entire lifetime of memories in the time they have left. He begins planning experiences, adventures, and moments they would normally take years to experience, determined to make every day meaningful.
As their relationship grows deeper, Daryn begins to realize that love isn't about controlling how much time someone has. Isabelle encourages him to stop living according to everyone else's expectations and start experiencing life for himself. Their relationship forces Daryn to reconsider his future, his family, and what truly makes a life meaningful.
The film explores themes of love, mortality, family, sacrifice, grief, dreams, and appreciating the present. Rather than focusing only on the sadness of losing someone, the story emphasizes the importance of making the time you have count.
What makes Life in a Year so emotional is the way Daryn's perspective changes. He begins believing that he can give Isabelle more life by filling her remaining time with unforgettable experiences, but eventually discovers that she is the one teaching him how to truly live.
More than just a love story, Life in a Year is a reminder that a meaningful life isn't measured only by how many years we have, but by what we choose to do with the time we're given.
💬 If you knew someone you loved had only one year left, what would you do with that time?

source_details.synopsis: Life in a Year is a 2020 American romantic drama film directed by Mitja Okorn from a screenplay by Jeffrey Addiss and Will Matthews. The film stars Jaden Smith, Cara Delevingne, Cuba Gooding Jr., and Nia Long. Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith serve as executive producers under their Overbrook Entertainment banner. The film was released in the United States on November 27, 2020, on Amazon Prime Video by Sony Pictures Releasing.
